  • Method Details

    • deleteDocument

      @RequestMapping(method=DELETE, value="/api/documents/{id}") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> deleteDocument(@PathVariable("id") String id)
      DELETE /api/documents/{id} : Deletes a document Deletes one of the caller's documents; an administrator may delete any. Needs scope documents.delete and a recent strong authentication (RFC 9470). Someone else's document is answered 404, like a missing one.
      Parameters:
      id - Unique identifier of the document. (required)
      Returns:
      The document was deleted. (status code 204) or Missing or invalid bearer token, or (RFC 9470) a valid token that does not prove a recent enough strong authentication: its acr claim is not the required one or its auth_time is older than the maximum age. The client must send the user through the authorization server again, asking for the acr_values and max_age of the challenge. (status code 401) or The token lacks the documents.delete scope. (status code 403) or The document does not exist or belongs to someone else. (status code 404)

    • listDocuments

      @RequestMapping(method=GET, value="/api/documents", produces="application/json") org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<List<DocumentResponse>> listDocuments()
      GET /api/documents : Lists documents Lists the caller's documents; an administrator sees all. Needs scope documents.read.
      Returns:
      The documents. (status code 200) or Missing or invalid bearer token. (status code 401) or The token lacks the documents.read scope. (status code 403)
